title: Crypto misuse: CMAC sess_reset double-free on error path
description: wolfssl_cmac_aes_sess_reset() in src/providers/wolfssl/wolfssl_cmac.c (under #ifdef HAVE_CMAC_FREE): calls wc_CmacFree(), then wc_InitCmac(). If wc_InitCmac() fails (~line 127), returns error without clearing ctx->inited. Subsequent wolfssl_cmac_aes_sess_free() calls wc_CmacFree() on the already-freed Cmac struct → double-free. Conditional on HAVE_CMAC_FREE being defined. Same structural bug as HMAC variant.
